settings.title: Attendance Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure arrival times, late thresholds, and attendance policies
settings.whoHelp: Each group has its own arrival/presence window. Configure {{learners}} and {{staff}} separately, or set an {{everyone}} default. A group-specific window always overrides the Everyone default.
settings.noWindow: No {{scope}} window yet — fill the fields below and save to create one.
settings.dayVsBoardingHelp: Leave this on {{everyone}} if your day and boarding populations share one policy. To give boarding students a different window (or the continuous-presence policy below), switch here and save a separate rule — it only applies to students classified as boarding on the {{list}}.
settings.presenceHelp: Boarding students generally reside at school. {{daily}} (default) means a boarding student still needs a biometric punch like anyone else. {{continuous}} means a boarding student who is checked in stays policy-recognized present on days with no new punch, until checked out or put on leave — check a student in or record leave from their profile. This never overrides an actual punch; it only fills in when there is none.
settings.validityHelp: Leave blank for indefinite (a check-in stays valid until someone explicitly checks the student out or records leave). Set a number of days to require fresh evidence periodically instead.
settings.savedWithRule: The choices above (population and manual check-in presence) are part of the attendance rule and are saved with it.
settings.arrivalStartHelp: When attendance tracking begins each day
settings.arrivalEndHelp: After this time, learners are marked late
settings.lateThresholdHelp: Grace period after arrival end time before marking "late"
settings.absenceCutoffHelp: After this time, anyone who hasn't checked in is marked absent
settings.closingHelp: End of school day — departure scans expected around this time
settings.duplicateHelp: Ignore repeated scans from the same person within this window
settings.schoolDaysHelp: Days the school operates. Punches on non-school days are recorded as "weekend/closed" and don't count as present/late or trigger parent SMS. Schools that teach on Saturday/Sunday should enable those days.
settings.oneDay: Select at least one school day.
settings.daySpecificHelp: Some days differ — e.g. "Saturday arrival ends at 10:00". Set an on-time cutoff (and optional grace minutes) for a specific day; leave a day blank to use the standard times above. Overrides apply to lateness verdicts, the dashboard, and the allowance report.
settings.savedTogether: Saved together with the {{scope}} window using the button below.
settings.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief note about this rule set...

quiet.title: SMS Quiet Hours
quiet.help: A punch that happens inside this window never texts a parent — for example, boarding learners known to trigger the device overnight (e.g. around 1 AM). The punch, the attendance record, and biometric evidence are unaffected; only the SMS is held back.
quiet.midnight: A window that crosses midnight (e.g. 23:00 → 05:00) is handled correctly.

lesson.intro: Turns biometric punches into per-lesson attendance using your timetable. A school-entry punch never counts as proof of attending every lesson. Learners who are not on the biometric system are shown as “not accounted for”, never auto-marked absent.
lesson.checkinHelp: Punches earlier than this don’t count for the lesson.
lesson.lateUntilHelp: Between grace and this = “late”. Later punches don’t count.
lesson.minPresenceHelp: 0 = one check-in is enough. Otherwise a first and a later punch this far apart are needed; one alone stays “pending”.

boarding.title: Boarding attendance policy
boarding.intro: How should attendance work for learners marked as {{boarding}}? Day scholars always follow the daily attendance rules.
boarding.noBoarders: No learner is marked as Boarding yet, so this policy has nobody to apply to. Set a learner’s {{residence}} to Boarding on the learners list.

boarding.onceBody: A boarding learner is considered reported after their first valid arrival punch for the reporting period. They will not be treated as absent merely because they do not punch again.

boarding.smsToggle: Send the parent an SMS when a boarder first reports to school

CORRECT_BY_DRIFT.label: Correct by drift
CORRECT_BY_DRIFT.hint: Trust device time unless it reads in the future; recover the real time from learned drift. Best default.

TRUST_DEVICE_TIME.label: Trust device time
TRUST_DEVICE_TIME.hint: Store exactly what the device reports. Never correct. Use only if every device clock is reliable.

TRUST_SERVER_RECEIVE_TIME.label: Trust server time
TRUST_SERVER_RECEIVE_TIME.hint: Stamp every punch with the moment DRAIS received it. Accurate for realtime, wrong for offline backlog.

MANUAL_REVIEW_IF_DRIFT.label: Flag for review
MANUAL_REVIEW_IF_DRIFT.hint: Keep device time but flag punches that drift beyond the limit for a human to check.

ADAPTIVE_DRIFT_NO_MEMORY.label: Adaptive (unstable clock)
ADAPTIVE_DRIFT_NO_MEMORY.hint: For a device with a failing RTC battery whose clock jumps between unrelated readings instead of drifting smoothly. Never trusts a remembered offset from an earlier batch — only ever corrects using fresh evidence from the current batch of punches; if there isn’t enough yet, keeps the safe fallback instead of guessing from stale memory.

timePolicy.title: Device Time Policy
timePolicy.intro: Controls how DRAIS interprets biometric device clocks. Raw device time, server-received time, and the corrected time are always stored — this only chooses which one attendance uses, and whether DRAIS may change the device clock.
timePolicy.whenWrong: When the device clock is wrong
timePolicy.maxDriftHelp: Beyond this, a clock is treated as faulty (correct/flag depending on policy).
timePolicy.autoSyncHint: When ON, DRAIS pushes the correct time to a drifting device. OFF = DRAIS never changes your machine's clock.
timePolicy.backlogHint: Keep original timestamps for punches uploaded after the device was offline.
timePolicy.showBothHint: Display both the device's reported time and the corrected time in logs.
